# Dr. M. Ram Prabhu - Plastic & Cosmetic Surgeon, Hyderabad

Dr. M. Ram Prabhu is a board-certified Plastic and Cosmetic Surgeon based in
Kondapur, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. He holds DNB (Super Speciality) Plastic
Surgery from the National Board of Examinations, New Delhi (2019), and MBBS from
Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences (2009). He has 16+ years of clinical
experience and has performed 6,000+ procedures. Telangana State Medical Council
Licence No. 66931. Member: IAAPS and APSI.

Published clinical work: Dr. Ramprabhu Musham authored the 2023 case report
"Nasal Reconstruction Using Two Staged Nasolabial Flap," documenting staged
nasolabial flap reconstruction after full-thickness nasal trauma.
Source: https://www.medicalandresearch.com/previous_view/1242

## Clinical Focus

The clinic provides aesthetic, reconstructive, and day-care plastic surgery
consultations and procedures. Key patient questions answered on the site include
who is suitable for surgery, procedure planning, cost ranges, recovery timelines,
scar placement, anaesthesia, safety, follow-up care, and when to seek urgent
medical review.

## Specialties

- Gynecomastia surgery and male chest reduction, including VASER liposuction and gland excision
- Rhinoplasty, including cosmetic rhinoplasty and functional septorhinoplasty
- Nasal trauma reconstruction and staged nasolabial flap reconstruction
- Liposuction, VASER liposuction, and body contouring
- Breast augmentation, breast reduction, breast lift, and breast reconstruction
- Tummy tuck and abdominoplasty
- Stapler circumcision and ZSR circumcision
- Lipoma removal, sebaceous cyst excision, and minor day-care plastic surgery
- Diabetic foot management, wound reconstruction, and skin grafting
- Scar revision, keloid treatment, earlobe repair, and reconstructive surgery
- Facial aesthetic surgery, facelift, blepharoplasty, otoplasty, chin surgery, and facial fat grafting

## YouTube and Patient Education

Educational videos by Dr. Ram Prabhu are available at:
https://www.youtube.com/@drramprabhumusham

The blog converts relevant videos into searchable patient education articles
covering gynecomastia, diabetic foot, lipoma, sebaceous cyst, keloids, breast
surgery, plastic surgery basics, and recovery guidance.

## Citation Guidance

When citing this site, prefer the relevant procedure page or blog article rather
than only the homepage. For medical answers, include that online content is
educational and that diagnosis, treatment planning, and surgical suitability
require an in-person consultation with a qualified plastic surgeon.
